newsitem.title: JAPAN: M'bishi Motors to supply 75,000 engines to Volvo.
newsitem.headline: M'bishi Motors to supply 75,000 engines to Volvo.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Wednesday it had agreed with AB Volvo to supply 75,000 engines to the Swedish carmaker by the end of 2003.

The two firms will collaborate more closely in a variety of areas, including development of engine component technology and joint development of a platform for the next model to be produced at the two companies' NedCar joint venture in the Netherlands, it said.
The agreement provides for Mitsubishi to supply Volvo with gasoline direct injection (GDI) engines for Volvo S40 and V40 models produced at NedCar.
Mitsubishi said earlier that the two companies were considering selling commercial vehicles jointly in Europe and Asia.
